core_meaning.primary_meaning: Lazzat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pleasure, delight, enjoyment”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Lazzat corresponds to the Arabic form لذة (Arabic root ل ذ ذ (l-dh-dh); لَذَّة (Ladhdha)). Its core sense is pleasure, delight, enjoyment. Lazzat is Arabic لَذَّة (Ladhdha) 'pleasure, delight, enjoyment', from the root ل ذ ذ (l-dh-dh); the form لَذَّت is the Persian/Urdu rendering. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave لزّات (a different form); the correct form is لَذَّة. The source gloss 'Taste, Delight' is broadly consistent.

persian.name: لذت
persian.long_meaning: Lazzat (لذت) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن لذت، خوشی، کامرانی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: लज़्ज़त
